scored_opportunities.name: Spec-to-Quote Extractor Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Parses incoming customer emails and web forms to extract trailer dimensions, custom options, and quantities, then drafts a pricing quote in the ERP for sales rep review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual spec entry causes errors and delays; no automated extraction from customer requests.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value due to direct impact on sales cycle speed and error reduction, low risk as it operates in draft mode with human approval.

scored_opportunities.name: Dealer Onboarding Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Guides new dealers through credential verification, auto-fills onboarding paperwork, and provisions portal access based on compliance checks.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual onboarding paperwork and fragmented communication delay dealer activation.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Strong operational value by accelerating dealer activation, moderate effort due to system integrations, risk managed by phased read-only validation.

scored_opportunities.name: Warranty Claim Triage Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Classifies incoming warranty requests, extracts serial numbers and purchase dates from emails, matches them to registration records, and flags missing documents for human review.
scored_opportunities.gap: Lengthy claim verification and tracking missing warranty documents slows resolution.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value through faster claim processing and better customer experience, moderate effort due to legacy system matching, risk kept low by mandatory human review for payouts.

scored_opportunities.name: Lender Document Pre-Screener Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Collects dealer/customer financial documents, formats them to specific lender requirements, and pre-screens against basic credit criteria before submission.
scored_opportunities.gap: Lengthy approval cycles and manual document submission cause sales drop-offs.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Solid value by reducing approval friction, moderate effort for portal integrations, low risk as it strictly handles document preparation without making lending decisions.

scored_opportunities.name: Component Shortage Predictor Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Monitors inventory levels of specialized components, cross-references with production schedules, and alerts procurement when stock falls below threshold for upcoming builds.
scored_opportunities.gap: Supply chain delays for specialized components cause production bottlenecks during peak season.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Moderate value by preventing costly line stoppages, higher effort due to ERP integration complexity, low risk as it only generates alerts without altering inventory records.

scored_opportunities.name: Freight & Packaging Knowledge Base
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Standardizes and indexes all past freight damage reports, carrier performance logs, and packaging specifications into a searchable knowledge base for future reference.
scored_opportunities.gap: No centralized historical data on freight damage or carrier performance to inform packaging/shipping decisions.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Low value/effort/risk as a standalone, but critical enabler that unlocks future logistics and quality agents by providing structured historical data.
